# .github/requirements-esp-idf-size.txt
#
# esp-idf-size pin for CI, installed via pip in the ESPHome build jobs to break
# the flash usage of each build down by archive and file, from its linker map.
# Pinned here so Dependabot can track and propose version updates (picked up by
# the `pip` ecosystem in .github/dependabot.yml).
#
# Kept apart from .github/requirements.txt so an esp-idf-size update only
# affects the size breakdown, which never fails a build.
#
# Used by:
#   - .github/scripts/esphome_size_breakdown.py (from .github/workflows/esphome_build.yml)

esp-idf-size==2.3.2
